faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the sponsored project framework of IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is 11 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a minimum 4-year Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Electrical/Electrical and Electronics Engineering or equivalent along with a national-level test qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third year as SRF.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is completely online. Candidates need to submit their applications through the provided Google Form link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official recruitment notification released by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can access the official website at https://iitr.ac.in and find direct download and application links in the Important Links section above.
